description: This file, RDKShell.h, defines the interface and class structures for the RDKShell plugin, including its initialization, various method wrappers, event notifications, internal components like event listeners, task queue, and a screen capture implementation. It provides the API for managing application windows, screen resolutions, input events, and system events within the RDK hardware/software environment.

classes.name: RDKShell
classes.description: Main class providing the interface for the RDKShell plugin, managing application windows, system events, input, and notifications. It encapsulates event listeners, a task queue, and nested classes for event handling and screen capture.

classes.name: RdkShellListener
classes.description: Event listener subclass for handling RDKShell events, such as application lifecycle events and system warnings.

classes.name: MonitorClients
classes.description: Class implementing plugin notification interface to monitor client plugin states and lifecycle events.

classes.name: ScreenCapture
classes.description: Implementation of ICapture interface to handle screen capture data, methods for capturing screen images, and camera on-screen capture events.

classes.name: TaskQueue
classes.description: Thread-safe queue for scheduling tasks asynchronously within RDKShell, using std::function.

classes.name: PluginData
classes.description: Structure holding plugin class name, used for plugin management.

classes.name: PluginStateChangeData
classes.description: Manages plugin state change events and connection resets, associated with specific plugin lifecycle.
